meaning_en: to sinter / fuse mineral grains into solid body under heat

past.ar: لَزَّ حَبُّ الكُوَارْتْزِ عِنْدَ اشْتِدَادِ الحَرَارَةِ
past.de: Das Quarzkorn sinterte bei zunehmender Hitze zusammen
past.en: The quartz grains sintered tightly as heat intensified

present.de: Er sintert das Silikapulver zu festem Scherben
present.en: It sinters the silica powder into solid stone-paste

imperative.en: Sinter with steady, calibrated temperature progression!
